description: Ministry of Defence - The Uttama Seva Padallama for the Year 2021 - for the Sri Lanka Three Armed Forces
categorisation: This gazette exclusively lists named individuals (military officers) receiving an award (Uttama Seva Padakkama). It contains personnel changes (awards) with basic titles/ranks only (e.g., "Maj", "Capt") but does NOT include any detailed descriptions of their portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2).
